name: stream_distanceBiasOtherFoliageCardImposter
desc: The higher the value the lower the streaming priority of images of this type

name: stream_distanceCulledImagesDeprioBegin
desc: Distance metric at which the bias for culled images kicks in. Images that have a distance metric further away than this (i.e. higher) and are culled by the CPU will have their metric value biased higher making them more likely to be unloaded.

name: stream_distanceCulledImagesDeprioBeginBR
desc: Same as stream_distanceCulledImageDeprioBegin but applied only in battle royale maps.

name: stream_distanceCulledImagesDeprioBias
desc: Distance metric bias applied to the distance metric of fully culled (via CPU frustum or occlusion culling) images. The higher this bias the more likely culled images are to be unloaded. Set this to 0 to disable the feature.

name: stream_distanceCulledImagesDeprioBiasRampFrames
desc: Number of stream update frames the deprioritization bias gets ramped up for culled images. If a culled image will be deprioritized it'll take this many stream update frames to reach the max bias value set by stream_distanceCulledImagesDeprioBias.

name: stream_distanceImageNeeded
desc: Distance metric at which images are considered 'needed' by the graphics card.

name: stream_distanceImageNeededForTransientZone
desc: Minimum streaming distance we must have before making a transient zone visible

name: stream_farAwayHeightmapsStreamingDistance
desc: Streaming distance to use for these heightmaps on terrain that are far away

name: stream_freezeState
desc: Freeze the state of all streaming memory - don't allow streaming or un-streaming of any streamed data. This essentially fully disables the stream update.

name: stream_freqDomainMetricBiasEnable
desc: Determines if the frequency domain stream distance metric bias the linker precomputes per image is applied during the streamer's update.

name: stream_hintDynamicXModelsMeshes
desc: Ensure that streamer request the mesh lods during stream update, and not just at render time

name: stream_introCinematicThrottlingMbPerSec
desc: Throttle streaming to the specified megabytes per second during intro cinematics.

name: stream_maxAnticipatedVelocity

name: stream_missingXModelLodBoost
desc: Amount to boost missing xmodel lods by

name: stream_primerMaxInFlight

name: stream_primerMaxInFlightForTransients
desc: Number of inflight primer reads when loading transients

name: stream_primerReleaseHeapDelayMS
desc: Amount of time to wait (in ms) before release heap pages back to streamer. To minimize having to wait when loading lots of FF.

name: stream_primerRequestStreamerToYield
desc: Streamer yield to always loaded assets (aka, stream primer)

name: stream_readAheadMaxDistanceRange
desc: Max read-ahead stream distance offset from the current item being requested for read. Used by the greedy multi-item packed read to read ahead. Only used when stream_readPacked is enabled.

name: stream_readFavorSeekOrder
desc: Instead of always picking the top item off the sort lists, when this is enabled a whole bunch of high priority items are picked off the sort lists, then sorted by seek order, and reads are issued in that order.

name: stream_readMaxInFlight
desc: Maximum number of file block buffers the regular stream read code path uses. This determines the maximum number of inflight reads at any point in time by the streamer.

name: stream_readPackedMaxGapKB
desc: Maximum gap in KB between items in a packed multi-item read. Will be rounded to disk read alignment block size. This is effectively the maximum allowed waste in between items that we end up reading from disk but we don't use.

name: stream_readSeekOrderMaxSizeKB_Generic
desc: Combined max size in KBs of how many generics are picked off the sort lists for the seek order queue. Only relevant when stream_readFavorsSeekOrder is enabled.

name: stream_readSeekOrderMaxSizeKB_Image
desc: Combined max size in KBs of how many image parts are picked off the sort lists for the seek order queue. Only relevant when stream_readFavorsSeekOrder is enabled.

name: stream_readSeekOrderMaxSizeKB_Mesh
desc: Combined max size in KBs of how many meshes are picked off the sort lists for the seek order queue. Only relevant when stream_readFavorsSeekOrder is enabled.

name: stream_smoothingFactorMovingFullSpeed
desc: Used to prevent sudden changes in reported streaming quality when view is moving quickly

name: stream_smoothingFactorNotMoving
